introduction.en: Money has evolved from commodity-based systems to fiat and digital forms, serving as the backbone of economic transactions. It has transformed from a simple medium of exchange to a complex tool for financial stability.
introduction.hi: Money has evolved from commodity-based systems to fiat and digital forms, serving as the backbone of economic transactions. It has transformed from a simple medium of exchange to a complex tool for financial stability.

body.en: The primary functions of money include acting as a medium of exchange and a unit of account, which eliminate the inefficiencies of the barter system. Secondary functions like store of value and standard of deferred payment allow for capital accumulation and credit-based growth. In the modern economy, these functions enable global trade, complex financial markets, and monetary policy implementation by central banks.

conclusion.en: The transition toward digital currencies and CBDCs represents the next phase in the evolution of money, promising greater efficiency and financial inclusion in the global economy.
